Someone I knew was trying to un-ham himself and return to humankind. He was doing a "low-carb, high-fat" Paleo, or keto-style diet.

I follow something similar due to my stomach rejecting lots of things with carbs, so we were talking about it.

He was trying to lose weight, and I was explaining about eating at a deficit. When he didn't grasp the concept, and was just counting carbs, not calories, too, I should have known. He said, "I AM eating at a deficit. I only had 12 net carbs yesterday. That's less then the 20g of carbs I am allowed!. "

No, I explained, you have to eat at a calorie deficit as well. I explained CICO. I thought he got it. A few weeks later, I saw him again at our regularly scheduled game, and I asked how he was doing.

"I'm not down much, I've only lost 1 pound over three weeks!"

So, I have him go over the foods, and his diet.

He tells me, "Well, I have been eating at 1800 to 2000 every day, except my cheat days!"

A RED FLAG appears in my head. With ketogenic diets, cheat days are pretty much taboo if they go WAY over, as you get kicked out of ketosis. "What do you mean, cheat days?" I query.

"Well, every Sunday I go to my dad's and we split a HALF GALLON of Cookies and Cream ice cream with our fresh baked cookies. We split one of those big tubes of Nestle chocolate chip cookie rolls."

I shit myself. "Dude, that is like 3500 calories in SWEETS alone! Is that all you eat?"

"No, we usually have burgers and fries, too. And pancakes for breakfast."

So, idiot ham would eat at a roughly 500 kcal deficit for 6 days (3000 saved) ,and then plow about 7000 kcal in on "cheat day."

I tell him, "So over the course of the week, you are actually OVER calories by about 1500 kcal. That's not a deficit."

"BUT IT'S A CHEAT DAY! Those calories don't count!"

At our next game, "How's the diet going? Any progress?"

"No, I quit that, It DOESN'T WORK"
